title: E-Commerce Products Officer
company: Walk Wheel Cycle Trust - Agency - Permanent
description:
E-Commerce Products Officer

When registering to this job board you will be redirected to the online application form. Please ensure that this is completed in full in order that your application can be reviewed.

E-Commerce Products Officer.

Location UK-wide.

£27,347 per annum (pro rata for part time).

Ref: 226 REC.

Part Time 30 hours per week - we are happy to talk flexible working.

Base: UK-based hybrid working, including travel to team meetings.

Contract: Fixed Term 1-year maternity cover.

Disclosure: DBS is not required for this position as the post holder will not be working with school and community groups in the region.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Team: Fundraising and Supporter Engagement.

The E-Commerce Products Officer will help grow the Walk Wheel Cycle Trust's online shop by creating new products, spotting and implementing exciting product opportunities, shaping a trusted and sustainable range, managing inventory and creating online listings that turn supporter interest into income for our work.

What you'll get stuck into
- Use customer insight and sales data to spot what supporters want next, shape seasonal collections, and help grow sales and profit.
- Find and assess new suppliers so our product range is distinctive, reliable and aligned with our commitment to sustainability.
- Bring products to life on Shopify with clear, engaging pages that help supporters choose with confidence and enjoy a smooth buying experience.
- Work closely with the E-Commerce Promotions Officer to make product launches and campaigns as successful as possible, maximising income for our mission.
- Lead the development of our next range of Network Cycle Planners, managing the project from planning through to delivery, coordinating suppliers and internal teams, and creating clear, engaging content for the digital guides.
- Manage inventory, using sales data to plan ahead, reorder at the right time and keep the right products in stock.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys spotting opportunities, developing new products, improving online shopping experiences, and seeing their work generate income for a cause they care about.

ABOUT YOU

We're looking for someone who enjoys making online shopping easy, engaging and effective. You'll bring curiosity, commercial awareness, and a practical eye for detail. We don't expect you to tick every box. If you're looking for a role where you can make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.
- You'll be confident taking ownership of projects, managing deadlines, and coordinating with a range of stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.
- Bring hands-on experience of Shopify or a similar e-commerce platform, with a good sense of what makes an online store easy to use and successful.
- Build strong relationships with retailers, wholesalers and external suppliers, helping to source the right products and make sure stock is available when supporters need it.
- Communicate clearly and confidently, creating, editing and proofreading content that is accurate, engaging and easy for supporters to understand.

LIVING OUR VALUES

At the Walk Wheel Cycle Trust, we're a values driven organisation. We're looking for people who are:

Always Learning - curious, open minded and committed to continuous improvement.

Championing Equity - inclusive, respectful and focused on ensuring everyone has a voice and fair opportunity to succeed.

Taking Ownership - proactive, responsible and empowered to make things better.

Delivering Together - collaborative, transparent and motivated by shared success.

Through our values we make it possible for more people to walk, wheel and cycle safely, healthily and joyfully.

WHAT WE OFFER

We want you to feel supported, valued, and empowered in your role. That's why we offer flexible working, a positive team environment, and benefits designed to support your wellbeing, finances, and family life.

WellbeingSupport
- 28 days' leave per annum plus bank holidays for full-time employees,
- Option to buy an extra week of annual leave (pro-rata for part-time employees).
- Paid volunteer days to support causes you care about.
- Free, confidential support service available 24/7.
- Access to cycle-to-work schemes through Green Commute Initiative and Cycle Scheme.

FinancialBenefits
- Up to two extra days of paid leave (pro rata for part time colleagues) when travelling sustainably for holidays.
- Group Personal Pension scheme with a 6% or 7% of basic salary contribution being matched by Walk Wheel Cycle Trust.
- Bike, computer and season ticket loans.
- Discount benefits.
- London Weighting Allowance of £4,530 per annum, pro rata for all those living within a London Borough (32 local authority districts plus the City of London).
- Death in Service benefit - 3 x annual Salary.

Family FriendlyPolicies
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
- Flexible Working practices (full time hours are 37.5 per week, Monday - Friday).

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- Application deadline: 23:59, 11 October 2026.
- Interviews will be held via Microsoft Teams during the 29th or 30th October 2026. To apply, please complete our online application form.
- We actively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, particularly those underrepresented in our workforce, including people of colour and candidates with disabilities. Adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process.
- Adjustments are available throughout the application process.

title: CRM & Lifecycle Manager
description:
CRM & Lifecycle Manager

£45,000 - £50,000 Base + Benefits

Bristol (Hybrid - 2 days remote per week)

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced CRM & Lifecycle Manager to take ownership of the customer relationship beyond acquisition, using customer data, insight and targeted communications to increase retention, repeat purchasing and long-term customer value.

The role will manage the customer journey from initial welcome and first purchase through to repeat purchasing, retention and re-engagement. A key part of the position will be developing Garden Rewards, alongside future loyalty initiatives, into a more compelling and valuable membership proposition.

This is a commercially focused CRM position, with success measured through customer value, revenue, retention and lifetime value rather than simply communication volumes or engagement metrics.

Key Areas of Responsibility:

CRM & Customer Lifecycle
- Develop and lead the CRM and customer lifecycle strategy, ensuring communications are tailored around customer behaviour, interests, value and position within the customer journey.
- Manage the overall commercial email strategy, covering audience selection, segmentation, targeting, communication frequency, testing and ongoing optimisation.
- Design, implement and continually improve automated customer journeys, including welcome, browse abandonment, basket abandonment, post-purchase, second-purchase and reactivation activity.
- Establish and maintain meaningful customer segments based on purchasing behaviour, customer value, history and lifecycle stage.
- Use segmentation and behavioural insight to improve customer relevance and commercial outcomes.
- Develop personalised CRM communications across email and other appropriate channels, working alongside Brand & Content to ensure the customer experience remains consistent with the wider brand.

Loyalty & Customer Value
- Lead the strategy and ongoing performance of Garden Rewards, with the objective of evolving it from a primarily promotional tool into a meaningful loyalty and membership proposition.
- Develop and enhance the benefits available through Garden Rewards, including early access, product previews, relevant seasonal content, selected offers, partner benefits and recognition for higher-value customers.
- Establish and deliver strategies designed to increase repeat purchasing, improve retention and bring lapsed customers back into the customer base.
- Place particular emphasis on improving the transition from a customer's first purchase to their second purchase.
- Take ownership of CRM-generated revenue and revenue attributed to lifecycle automation, ensuring activity is assessed on its commercial contribution rather than solely on opens, clicks or send volumes.
- Lead the analysis and development of customer lifetime value, incorporating acquisition economics and insight from E-commerce around conversion and average order value.

Customer Insight & Reporting
- Analyse customer cohorts, behaviour and sentiment to identify useful trends and opportunities.
- Share relevant customer insight with E-commerce, Acquisition, Brand & Content and wider consumer planning teams to support broader commercial decision-making.
- Manage browse and basket abandonment communications, while working with E-commerce to identify and address the underlying onsite issues that may be contributing to abandonment.
- Partner with E-commerce on lifecycle cross-selling, product recommendations and customer behaviour, maintaining a clear distinction between onsite recommendations and personalised CRM communications.
- Produce clear weekly reporting covering retention, repeat purchasing and lifecycle performance, contributing to the wider consolidated consumer digital trading view.

Data & CRM Governance
- Take responsibility for CRM data quality, customer preferences and consent management.
- Work with technical and digital teams where necessary to maintain effective CRM data processes and ensure customer information can be used appropriately and effectively.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with strong practical experience across CRM, email, lifecycle or retention marketing, ideally gained within a consumer-facing or e-commerce environment.

You should be able to demonstrate:
- Hands-on experience developing, implementing and optimising automated customer journeys.
- Strong knowledge of customer segmentation, retention, repeat purchasing and customer lifetime value.
- The ability to use customer, cohort and behavioural data to inform decisions and improve performance.
- Experience working with CRM platforms, email automation systems, customer data platforms or comparable technologies.
- A commercially minded approach, with the ability to connect CRM activity to revenue, customer value and margin rather than relying solely on engagement measures.
- Strong analytical capability and confidence interpreting customer and behavioural data.
- A structured approach to testing, learning and continual optimisation.
- A good practical understanding of CRM data quality, customer preferences and consent requirements.
- Experience creating or developing loyalty, rewards or membership propositions would be beneficial.
- The ability to work collaboratively across multiple functions, particularly E-commerce, Acquisition, Brand & Content and Outreach & Partnerships.

Sector Experience:

Experience working within a premium consumer, garden, home, lifestyle or another considered-purchase environment would be advantageous, although relevant CRM and lifecycle experience from another consumer or e-commerce setting will also be considered.

title: CRM and Lifecycle Manager
description:
Tildenet Group is a multi-brand business operating across consumer and trade markets, with activities spanning horticulture, gardenware and specialist commercial sectors. Our portfolio includes consumer-facing brands such as Agriframes and Knowle Nets alongside Tildenet Gardenware and wider B2 B/commercial operations. We are ambitious for growth and are investing in stronger digital, e-commerce and customer capability to support the next stage of the business.

About the Role

The CRM & Lifecycle Manager is responsible for increasing the value of identified and existing customers through data-led CRM, lifecycle marketing, retention and loyalty. The role owns the customer relationship from welcome and first purchase through post-purchase, repeat purchase, retention and reactivation, and will develop Garden Rewards and future loyalty programmes into a stronger and more meaningful customer proposition.

Key Responsibilities
- Own the consumer CRM and lifecycle strategy, ensuring customers receive relevant communications and experiences according to their behaviour, value, interests and stage in the customer journey.
- Own the commercial email programme, including audience selection, segmentation, targeting, cadence, testing, optimisation and performance reporting.
- Build and optimise automated lifecycle journeys including welcome, browse abandonment, basket abandonment, post-purchase, second-purchase and reactivation programmes.
- Own customer segmentation by behaviour, value, purchase history and lifecycle stage and use this insight to improve relevance and commercial performance.
- Develop CRM personalisation across email and other relevant customer communications, working with Brand & Content to maintain a distinctive and consistent brand voice.
- Own Loyalty scheme strategy and performance, developing it beyond a promotional mechanism into a genuine loyalty and membership proposition.
- Develop Garden Rewards benefits including early access, previews, relevant seasonal content, selective offers, partner benefits and recognition of high-value customers.
- Own repeat-purchase, retention and lapsed-customer reactivation strategy, with particular focus on improving the journey to second purchase.
- Own CRM-attributable and lifecycle automation revenue, ensuring CRM activity is measured commercially rather than primarily by sends, opens or clicks.
- Own customer lifetime value analysis and development, using acquisition economics from Acquisition and conversion/AOV insight from E-commerce.
- Monitor customer cohorts, behaviour and sentiment and feed useful customer insight into E-commerce, Acquisition, Brand & Content and wider consumer planning.
- Own basket and browse abandonment recovery communications while E-commerce owns diagnosis and removal of the underlying onsite friction.
- Work with E-commerce on lifecycle cross-sell, product recommendations and customer behaviour, distinguishing onsite recommendations from CRM-led personalised communications.
- Own CRM data quality, customer preferences and consent processes, working with technical/digital support where required.
- Provide clear weekly retention, repeat-purchase and lifecycle reporting as an input to the consolidated consumer digital trading view.

Person Specification
- Strong hands-on CRM, email, lifecycle or retention marketing experience within a consumer or e-commerce business.
- Demonstrable experience building and optimising automated customer journeys.
- Strong understanding of customer segmentation, retention, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value.
- Experience developing loyalty, membership or rewards propositions would be advantageous.
- Commercial mindset with the ability to connect CRM activity to revenue, customer value and margin rather than engagement metrics alone.
- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with customer, cohort and behavioural data.
- Experience with CRM, email automation and customer data platforms or equivalent tools.
- Good understanding of consent, preferences and practical CRM data discipline.
- Strong testing and optimisation mindset.
- Collaborative approach and ability to work closely with E-commerce, Acquisition, Brand & Content and Outreach & Partnerships.
- Experience in premium consumer, garden, home, lifestyle or another considered-purchase category would be advantageous.

title: Marketing and Communications Officer
company: Bath & West Community Energy - Agency - Permanent
description:
We're looking for an enthusiastic and organised Marketing and Communications Officer to join our friendly team.

This is a varied and hands-on role that would suit someone who enjoys working with people, is confident communicating with different audiences, and is keen to develop their skills across marketing, communications and events.

This wide-ranging role could include production of social media content or updating our website, helping prepare for community events or gathering stories about the impact of our work. You'll work closely with colleagues across the organisation to help deliver engaging communications, support events and community activities, and ensure our members, supporters and stakeholders stay informed and connected.

As part of the role, you'll support the creation of newsletters, website content, blogs, press releases and other communications materials, as well as drafting engaging content for digital and print channels. You'll help gather stories, case studies and updates from colleagues, members and community partners, and help ensure our communications are accurate, engaging and aligned with BWCE's values and brand.

You'll also help maintain BWCE's social media channels, create simple graphics and promotional materials using Canva and existing templates, and support website updates and content management, with software training as required. You'll assist with monitoring engagement across our communications channels and gathering basic performance information.

Events and community engagement are also an important part of the role. You'll support the planning and delivery of events, workshops and community engagement activities, helping with registrations, event materials, presentations, signage and promotional resources. You'll also help coordinate practical arrangements with venues, suppliers and colleagues and gather feedback from participants.

Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support events, although attendance at all events is not expected.

We're looking for someone who is enthusiastic, positive and keen to learn, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with a wide range of people. You'll be organised, have good attention to detail and be comfortable using digital tools and learning new systems.

Experience creating content for social media, websites or newsletters, using Canva or similar design software, or supporting events and community activities would be helpful. Familiarity with WordPress, social media scheduling tools, CRM systems or event platforms such as Eventbrite would also be useful, but we welcome applications from people with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.

If you're enthusiastic, adaptable and eager to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join BWCE?

BWCE is one of the UK's leading community energy organisations. We develop renewable energy projects, support people to reduce their energy use, and invest in projects that benefit local communities.

This role offers the opportunity to develop a broad range of marketing, communications and engagement skills while working in an organisation that is making a positive difference.

If this sounds like the role for you, please visit our website for full details and to apply

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive Hybrid £32,000-£35,000 Permanent

The Marketing Executive will work closely with the Marketing Manager and become a key part of delivering the company's marketing new objectives.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We're recruiting for a Marketing Manager to join a growing and innovative business operating within highly technical markets. This Marketing Manager role sits at the heart of the organisation's growth plans, working closely with sales, product and technical teams to create engaging campaigns, generate demand and strengthen customer relationships. It's an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded Marketing Manager who enjoys combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. If you're a results-driven Marketing Manager with strong B2 B experience, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

As Marketing Manager, the successful candidate will lead the development and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns aligned to business objectives, customer needs and target sectors. The role will create compelling content, manage campaign delivery across digital and offline channels, and continually optimise activity to improve performance and results. A key focus will be driving demand generation through content marketing, email campaigns, exhibitions, events and targeted outreach. Working closely with sales teams, the position will ensure marketing activity supports pipeline growth, strengthens customer engagement and contributes to wider commercial objectives. The successful candidate will take ownership of key digital marketing channels, including website performance, SEO, paid media, CRM platforms and marketing automation tools. Responsibilities will include building effective customer journeys, enhancing lead nurturing processes and using data and insight to measure and improve marketing performance. In addition, the role will lead the planning and coordination of industry events and exhibitions, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to maximise engagement, generate commercial opportunities and strengthen the organisation's presence across priority markets.

What experience you'll need to apply
- Degree qualified or equivalent professional experience in marketing or a relevant discipline.
- 6-10 years' marketing experience within B2 B environments.
- Proven success delivering demand generation campaigns that drive measurable business results.
- Experience working within technology, engineering, manufacturing or other technical sectors.
- Strong knowledge of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and analytics.
- Experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns from planning through to execution and optimisation.
- Strong digital marketing expertise, including website management, SEO, email marketing and paid media.
- Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into actionable improvements.
- Experience collaborating closely with sales teams to support commercial objectives.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and project management skills.
- Proactive approach with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on delivery.
- Comfortable working within a fast-paced and evolving environment.

What you'll get in return for your experience

You'll receive a competitive salary + bonus and benefits alongside the opportunity to play a key role in a business that is investing heavily in future growth. You'll have the autonomy to shape marketing activity, influence business performance and work with experienced technical and commercial teams. In return for your expertise, you'll also benefit from ongoing professional development, hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements.

What's next?

If this sounds like the opportunity you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply via the apply button with your latest CV. Alternatively, if you'd like a confidential discussion about this role and whether it could be the right next step in your career, please get in touch with Ania.

Apply Today

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
